THE_GENERATION_NAMESPACE.why_it_is_disjoint: _flat escapes a source path's components and emits ONLY '%25' for a literal per-cent and '%2F' for the separator, so no flattened source name can contain '%23'. A provider file genuinely called `s.jsonl%232` escapes to `s.jsonl%25232` and a file called `s.jsonl#2` stays itself -- both are held apart from a generation by cases.
